# Retail CoD 1.5b dedicated server configstring table at gamestate.

# Captured with tools/run_server.sh and --net-probe at debug level.
# Recipe: COD_LNXDED_HOME at a fresh homepath (game module only, no cfg) whose main/ holds a
# zzz_motd.pk3 with mp_carentan.bsp rebuilt by tools/bsp_worldspawn_key.py to carry
# worldspawn "message" "vcod worldspawn message" (configstring 4), then
# COD_VERSION=1.5 tools/run_server.sh mp_carentan +set g_motd '"Welcome to vcod"'
# +set scr_motd '"scr motd text"' +set sv_hostname '"vcod motd host"'
# +set scr_allow_vote 0 +set sv_privateClients 2, and the probe's
# --save-configstrings --capture-tag motd-15. Read by the configstrings gates.
# One '<index> <value>' line per non-empty slot, ascending. Values are raw;
# a configstring cannot contain a newline, so no escaping is needed.
# 0 (serverinfo) and 1 (systeminfo) are recorded for provenance and excluded
# from the diff: they carry pak checksums and server config, not script output.
